Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old boy spent almost three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after allegedly giving law enforcement a false name and birthday. The city took 20 days to verify that he was a minor, despite being alerted to the possibility almost immediately after his arrest. During that time, he was kept apart from other inmates in a section for people with special needs, according to his father and emails reviewed by the newsroom. The story also reported that an expert reviewed the boy’s dental X-ray and found him to be a minor; a judge later ordered his transfer to juvenile hall on $10,000 bail.

Story: https://missionlocal.org/2025/09/16-year-old-boy-held-s-f-adult-jail-almost-3-weeks/

Correction: An earlier version misstated the defendant’s age as 17; he is 16.
